description: Lists every file saved on a website, with each path and its size in bytes, beside the viewUrl, keepUrl, pages, passed and any problems. It changes nothing. The paths are the ones read_website_file and delete_website_file take.

editKey.description: The editKey start_website returned, which proves the website is the caller's. Leave it out for a website in the connected account.

websiteId.description: The websiteId start_website returned, or one list_sites shows.

name: list_website_files
title: List website files
